description:
The EXPLICIT go-live of a database built with data_pump_run(mode='golive') from a FRESH source
    copy taken in the maintenance window. Refused on a neutralised test copy.

    step='secrets': user password HASHES 1:1 (only after proving the target recognises every source
    hash scheme - same passlib pbkdf2_sha512 context in 19 and 20), API keys with the same hash and
    scope 'rpc' where they had none (20 needs it for XML-RPC/JSON-2), 2FA devices, secret columns
    of every model (e-invoicing credentials, mail server passwords, integration keys), and the
    system parameters the test build skipped (database identity, subscription code, base URL,
    e-invoicing mode). Values are never printed - only names and counts.
    step='crons': every scheduled action like in the source - active as in the source, the source
    interval/priority, the next run on the source's grid; actions new in the target are listed.
    Run 'secrets', verify, then 'crons' last (they start doing real work). `golive_ack=true`
    confirms this database is becoming PRODUCTION.
name: data_pump_golive
